desc: The X-Naut Fortress's crane game played and left (aji_03 on a finished file, the post-game's crane prizes on; the cog in and the crane powered by TTYD_GSWF 4196 and 4197, its first-use message read before, 4218): to the control panel, A at it, A held to slide the claw over keihin02 (the first batch's Fire Flower), B a moment, the claw drops and carries the prize to the chute; the crane goes back, Mario has his control again (the input script's where: control 1) and the prize lies off its shelf
